title: Israel attempts to jail Palestinian student at Hebrew University without trial
summary_full: Mahdi Tounsi appeared to have suffered maltreatment at hearing where he was not allowed to hear prosecution case against himPalestinian student Mahdi Tounsi appeared in a closed-door court hearing in Jerusalem, as academics and activists warned that Israel’s attempt to jail him without trial marked a serious escalation in attacks on Palestinian rights.Yael Berda, a lawyer and sociology professor at Hebrew University, who has taught Tounsi for four years, came to court to call for his release.
